method: Recompute the local K2 message and the direct incidence P7 obstruction from the frozen direct-encoding contract; do not import the primary result conclusion.

K2_message: After forbidding F, both vertices have the same remaining palette [4]\F.
K2 is list-colorable iff at least two colors remain, i.e. iff |F|<=2.
direct_path: Choose one q_i from each K2 component C_{e_i}.
The direct incidence encoding gives consecutive edges x_v1-q1-x_v2-q2-x_v3-q3-x_v4.
Distinct Y0 components remove component-component chords.
The chosen hyperedge incidences exclude every nonconsecutive survivor-component chord.
Therefore the displayed sequence is an induced P7.
hardness_contract: Without fixed-color or surjectivity conditions, all variables monochromatic satisfy every no-rainbow relation.
Thus local K2 relations alone are not a hardness proof.

limitations: Does not rule out a more elaborate source-valid hardness embedding using extra gadgets/edges while preserving semantics.
Does not prove polynomial composition of all P7-free message systems.
Does not resolve full L2 repair.
